name: CrypticMC
description:
CrypticMC is a long-term Minecraft survival server with a world that never resets. No land claims, no rollbacks, and griefing is allowed.

Only commands: /homes and /tpa

Supports Java 1.21+ and Bedrock Edition

Proximity Voice Chat

Java: crypticmc.org

Bedrock: bedrock.crypticmc.org (Port: 19132)
